title: Add Distribution Alpha release and provenance promotion gate
purpose: Upgrade release provenance so Alpha promotion records runtime manifest, image inputs, gate commands, and QEMU smoke evidence.
scope: Extend release metadata to include Alpha rootfs/runtime manifest hash.
Record runtime gate commands and results.
Record image inputs and QEMU smoke evidence link.
Reject promotion if runtime manifest, safety gates, or QEMU runtime smoke are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Provenance includes source revision, toolchain, dependency inventory, artifact hashes, runtime manifest hash, and image inputs.
Promotion gate includes cargo, safety, AgentCore, adversarial, release, and QEMU runtime checks.
Provenance stores hashes and paths, not raw secrets.
Generated provenance remains ignored unless intentionally promoted through evidence.
verification: Inspect provenance metadata for Alpha runtime fields.
Confirm generated artifacts are not staged.
risk_notes: Without Alpha-specific provenance, a boot artifact can be promoted without proving runtime content.
implementation_steps: Add Alpha runtime manifest metadata to release provenance.
Add or document promotion checks for runtime gates and QEMU smoke.
Run release script and inspect metadata.
Write task evidence summarizing generated artifact paths and hashes.
failure_modes: Promotion succeeds without QEMU runtime smoke.

verification_matrix.expected: Release gate passes and provenance includes Alpha runtime fields

blocked_until: Runtime manifest and QEMU smoke are promotion inputs.
